Hello! I really like your art style. Is it alright if you drew two characters (both of their references are in the document, sorry for the minimal amount of art for both of them). As for both the pose and clothing, feel free to come up with anything based on the description I have written.

The first boy, Lucas, has light blue hair and green eyes (color code: #519c76)! He is born with narcolepsy but personality wise he is like an ignorant rich kid who is inwardly a genius. He lacks facial expression and emotional responses. He wears a buttoned up white shirt and black trousers. He also has a disheveled appearance due to his disorder. 

The second boy, Vern, has black hair and blue eyes. He takes care of Lucas as a part time job for him. He's a college student who is caring and quite expressive despite his cold looks. He's quite fashionable and often likes to dress in browns and oranges. Vern often tries to help Lucas out with a lot of things including housework due to Lucas' condition.

Both of them have feelings for each other but are afraid of saying it out loud to each other. Lucas often faints a lot due to his condition so Vern usually drags Lucas around as well.
